Delivery, returns and warranty

All of it, before you check out.

Delivery

Shipping is free on every order. In-stock saunas ship within 2 to 4 business days in a PeakGuard wooden crate from Ontario, California, by freight. The carrier calls 1 to 2 days before delivery to schedule a 4-hour window. Standard delivery is curbside; white-glove or garage delivery is available for an extra fee.

Returns

Returns are accepted with the sauna disassembled and repacked in its original crate. All returns carry a 25% restocking fee, and you pay return shipping. Orders cancelled before shipping carry a 5% cancellation fee.

Warranty

7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page. Heating elements and cabinetry: 7 years. Control system, power supply and red light panel: 3 years. Chromotherapy lighting, audio, WiFi/app connectivity and accessories: 1 year. Original purchaser only, parts only, installation within 6 months of delivery.

Paying

Financing is available through Bread Pay at checkout. PEAK saunas may be eligible for HSA/FSA purchase through Redo. Every price is shown on the site; you do not need to talk to a salesperson to see it.

Included free

Peak Wellness Club comes with every sauna

Protocols from athletes and longevity doctors with temperature, duration, timing and breathwork for each; a streak leaderboard; and the Sauna Lounge, a private owner community.
